newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no trade-private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no trade-private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets were quiet near midday Friday following fairly active sales during the holiday-shortened week, market sources said.

No bids were reported but cattle feeders reportedly were asking $106.00 to $107.00 per cwt on a dressed basis and $66.00 to $67.00 on a live basis. Owners were expected to price cattle about the same early next week, sources said.
Sales this week totalled about 90,000 head, with top prices ranging from $105.00 to $106.00/dressed and $65.00/live, they said.
Showlists next week were expected steady to slightly smaller even with a light carryover from this week.
